# Oregon State Bar (OSBar)

> The Oregon State Bar's digital platform for bar licensees to access products, services, CLE education, and account management.

OSBar serves Oregon attorneys and legal professionals with an integrated ecommerce and education platform. The site provides access to essential legal products including Decisis legal research, BarBooks publications, and continuing legal education (CLE) seminars required for bar licensee compliance.

## Key Topics

- Oregon State Bar
- Bar Licensees
- CLE Seminars
- Continuing Legal Education
- Decisis
- BarBooks
- Legal Publications
- Product Catalog
- Authentication
- Account Access
- Shopping Cart
- PLF
- MCLE Comity
- Admissions
- Bookstore

## Authentication & Account Access

- [Log In](https://hello.osbar.org): OSBar login and authentication portal for bar licensees

## Products & Services

- [Product Catalog](https://hello.osbar.org/Product/catalog/index): OSB product catalog featuring Decisis, BarBooks, CLE seminars
- [OSB Product Catalog](https://ebiz.osbar.org/ebusiness/ProductCatalog/Product.aspx): OSB ecommerce product catalog with shopping and inventory

## Continuing Legal Education

- [OSB Product Catalog](https://ebiz.osbar.org/ebusiness/Meetings/Meeting.aspx): Oregon State Bar meeting registration and CLE course catalog
